_readme: Output columns for autox_vbo.py, in the order they appear in the .vbo file.
Each column needs: name (for [header]), short (for [column names]) and
format (a Python format spec), plus exactly one source:
key      - read this channel straight from the run JSON, optionally
derived  - computed by the script; see the list below
constant - the same value on every row
Optional: unit (adds a [channel units] entry), and required:false to drop
the column from runs whose log does not carry that key.
Derived sources: time, sats, latitude_min, longitude_min, heading,
Run 'python3 autox_vbo.py --list-channels' to see the active table.
